name: dispersion_trace
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du - m.Dv) * N

name: dispersion_det
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 + m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

name: quadratic_nonneg_of_disc
statement: ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c
note: first mutant (+1) was TRUE over Z (integrality) and was replaced by +4 before freeze

name: mode_trace_negative
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 < m.modeTr N M

name: instability_needs_S_positive
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.S < 0

name: det_positive_beyond_cutoff
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N + 1 → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

name: instability_below_cutoff
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N ≤ m.S * M - M

name: finite_domain_no_instability
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 + p ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)
note: algebraic core of the finite-domain exclusion (length (p/s)pi, Neumann)

name: no_instability_any_wavenumber
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ + 1 → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

name: hamilton_monotone_in_r
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C
mutant: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C

name: hamilton_rule_iff
statement: ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B
mutant: ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C ≤ r * B

name: hamilton_threshold_persists
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C
mutant: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C

name: hamilton_cost_monotone
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁
mutant: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂

name: dove_not_ess
statement: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < V → Scope.hdDD V C < Scope.hdHD V C
mutant: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < V → Scope.hdHD V C < Scope.hdDD V C

name: hawk_ess_iff_V_gt_C
statement: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < Scope.hdHH V C - Scope.hdDH V C ↔ C < V
mutant: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < Scope.hdHH V C - Scope.hdDH V C ↔ C ≤ V

name: instability_necessary_conditions
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ m.S ^ 2 < 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ
note: chain: T04 + T08 (which uses Q01 + T02)

name: instability_lower_bound
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M ≤ m.S * N - N

name: finite_domain_instability_needs_long_domain
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 ≤ m.S * p ^ 2 - p ^ 2

name: hurwitz_beyond_cutoff
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
mutant: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (-(m.modeDet N M))
